utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Dane, are you joining the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I might be a bit late, but count me in!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, glad you're in! Need me to bring any extra tools for you?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What's the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which repair drive do you mean?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The one people were talking about at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Noah, I've been tallying up what supplies we have for the drive. We're a bit short on lumber.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Lumber? Oh, right, the drive. I think I saw some boards behind my garage... or maybe that was last week.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you check on those boards? Lumber's really what we need most right now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Pia, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, it's just a neighborhood thing where we all chip in for minor repairs. But I'm a bit worried about how we're organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What's got you worried about it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly is the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I'm still getting the lay of the land, but I heard it's a community effort to fix up shared spaces.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who's organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus! Heard you were organizing that repair drive—need any help rounding up folks?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Tess! I'd appreciate that. Could you talk to the folks on Maple Street?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Gus! I'll head over to Maple Street this afternoon. Anyone in particular you want me to reach?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, I heard about the repair drive! What's the plan? I can help spread the word to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive's starting at 9 AM Saturday at the community center. I've got a list of items we're collecting.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I'll get the word out to the whole block! Can you share that list with me so I know what to tell folks?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, what's this about a repair drive? Need any help with it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? What exactly are you trying to fix?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I meant a community repair drive! We're collecting broken items to fix together this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo, I'm glad you could make it. I wanted to chat about the repair drive this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the repair drive. Sounds good, let me know what time and I'll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, it's from 10 AM to 4 PM on Saturday at the community center. We'd love to have your help!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Eli, are you going to the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I'll be there. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It starts at 10 AM on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I’m having a bit of a moment—could you remind me what that's about again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's a community thing to fix up the old playground equipment.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the playground! I remember now. Is there a date set for that?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I heard you're organizing a repair drive! I know a few people from the book club who might love to help out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's great to hear, Jules! The more hands, the better. Do you think they'd be interested in fixing up some old bikes or household items?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, definitely! Some of them are really handy with tools, so I bet they'd jump at the chance to fix bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I'm spreading the word about the repair drive this weekend. You in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, the repair drive? What time does it start? I might be a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It kicks off at 9 AM, but no worries if you're late—just come when you can!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Need a hand with anything for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I appreciate the offer! I'm all for helping out, but I like to have a clear schedule first. Do you know when we're starting?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not sure of the exact time, but I heard it's sometime this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Mara, I was thinking about the repair drive—did you see the sign-up sheet for volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I haven't looked at the sheet yet, but I'd love to help out. Where is it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's on the bulletin board by the school entrance; I'll send you a photo of it later if you want.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, how's the repair drive coming along? Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's going great! We're planning to fix up the community garden tools this Saturday at 10 AM. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Count me in! I'll bring some extra tools too. Anything specific you need?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Pia, I've got a bunch of tools in my shed if the repair drive needs any.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's great, Gus, but how would we get them to the drive site if everyone's busy?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, I can load them in my truck and drive them over myself.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good morning, Rosa! Do you have the list of houses for the repair drive? I like to keep a precise map of where everyone needs help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Good morning, Opal! Yes, I've got the list right here. Let me grab it and we can go over the details together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, let's get started. I have my map ready—where's the first house on the list?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's the schedule for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you clarify which repair drive you're referring to, and what details you need for the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The neighborhood repair drive we talked about last week. What days and times are people coming?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Cleo, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That'd be great, Sam! I could use some help sorting through the donated parts and tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I'd be happy to help sort through everything. When should I come over?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Noah, I heard we're organizing a repair drive. Can you tell me more about it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, a repair drive? I think I saw a flyer about that... somewhere. Sorry, I misplaced it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No worries! Do you remember any details from the flyer? I'm really interested in helping out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is actually happening? You sure about that?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's on for sure! I saw the flyers at the community center this morning.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Flyers? Huh. Well, I guess I'll believe it when I see it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Uli, how's the repair drive going? Any updates?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's coming along, slowly. Some parts are harder to find than I thought.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's tough. Hope you can track down what you need soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, a repair drive? I think I remember hearing about that... wait, what is it again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's a community event this Saturday to fix broken items. Bring anything that needs repairing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, Saturday! Right, right. I think I have a toaster that's been acting up. Should I bring it?
